A mixed plate with an apple, a fresh spring roll, several portions of roasted meat/poultry, and a small cooked vegetable or mushroom portion. Some meat identifications are uncertain.

### 2. Vessel

### 3. Items
Visible foods appear to be:
- Whole apple
- Fresh rice-paper vegetable/shrimp roll
- Central roasted poultry leg with an exposed bone
- Dark roasted meat with skin on the right
- Small portion of cooked mushrooms/vegetables above it
- Skin-on roast chicken at lower left
- A separate strip of white chicken meat

No distinct pool of sauce or separately measurable oil is visible.
